p_intro: Rhino for AutoJs6 is a fork of the Rhino JavaScript engine for [AutoJs6]({{ host_url }}). Based on Mozilla Rhino, this repository maintains Android compatibility and host integration, providing the engine source and a build entry for the complete JAR used by AutoJs6.
p_original: [Read the original official Rhino README]({{ upstream_readme_url }}). This entry is pinned to commit `{{ upstream_commit }}`, preserving the upstream language and the context of relative links. The original document is retained without translation; this page and its other language versions describe this fork.
p_original_sources: A byte-for-byte [README text snapshot]({{ upstream_archive_url }}) and its [provenance and verification record]({{ upstream_provenance_url }}) are also available. For maintained material, visit the [official Rhino repository]({{ upstream_repository_url }}) and [official documentation site]({{ upstream_documentation_url }}). The upstream [RELEASE-NOTES.md]({{ upstream_releases_url }}) remains in its original language.
scope_compatibility: Android reflection, thread contexts and compatibility with older systems, together with the scope and Java interoperability interfaces used by AutoJs6.
scope_xml: XML/E4X integration with AutoJs6 UI mode, retaining the XML parsing behavior required by the host.
scope_messages: Localized engine error messages, maintained separately from this repository's multilingual README/CHANGELOG documentation.
scope_packaging: A complete `rhino-all` JAR retaining desktop JVM tools and service resources, from which the host derives its Android runtime package.

p_build_output: The complete artifact is `rhino-all/build/libs/rhino-all-<version>.jar`, with the version taken from `gradle.properties`. It contains the core engine, tools, XML/E4X and JLine. Use this complete package for host integration.
p_checks: These commands initialize the test submodules, run the main module and integration tests, then run the full checks. On Windows, replace `./gradlew` with `.\gradlew.bat`.
p_integration: AutoJs6 references the complete JAR at `libs/org-mozilla-rhino-2_0_0-SNAPSHOT.jar`. The host's `slimRhinoJar` task derives an Android runtime package, removing JLine, the JVM optimizing compiler and JFR components while retaining the interpreter, XML and debugging support. Engine updates also require validation of host compilation, D8/APK packaging and relevant script behavior; a successful Rhino build alone does not establish these results.
p_links: [AutoJs6 repository]({{ host_url }}) / [AutoJs6 scripting documentation]({{ host_docs_url }}) / [Issues for this fork]({{ repo_url }}/issues). General Rhino APIs and upstream contribution guidance are available through the original official documentation entry.
p_changelog: This history records maintenance changes to this fork by date. Official Rhino release history remains in the upstream release notes and is not presented as new releases of this fork.
p_documentation: Edit the language JSON and templates in `.readme/` and `.changelog/`, then regenerate the documents. Simplified Chinese is the content baseline and the language of the root README. Python 3.10 or later is required, with no extra Python packages; Windows can use `py` instead of `python`. Generation and `--check` run offline, and check mode writes no files. CI on Windows and Ubuntu validates translation structure, references, original snapshot integrity and generated artifacts.
